text_fidelity_a:
Acer C720 Chromebook (11.6-Inch, 2GB) **Discontinued by Manufacturer** These are pretty much the perfect laptop for kids (and adults too if they don't want to download or install any personal programs). The Google App store has just about every type of app/program you could want. These don't have a DVD drive and you can't download programs unless they are from the App store. It's a good way of keeping your machine safe from malware attacks. No need to purchase and renew antiviral software. The screen is clear and bright, and the keyboard works really nicely. The sound from these is much better than the sound on my much more expensive laptop. Overall, the size and functionality of the Chromebook is much better than my new Windows 8.1 laptop.

My kids were able to get started immediately with minimal help from me to download some apps they like, get their e-mails set up and started using these Chromebooks immediately. I personally am not nuts about having only Google Chrome as my internet browser, thus I don't own my own Chromebook, but for my kids purposes (mainly games and schoolwork) the Chromebooks work out great. I really like how easy and smoothly they work. They are faster than my laptop and I do find that appealing, but I like being able to use a DVD drive and to be able to download what software I might want from the internet.

Printing is possible from the cloud and set up to do that is not difficult. Everything is easy........almost too easy. You can't store any data on the computer itself, only in the cloud. But, I'm not worried about any personal information being accessed by nefarious types because there's really nothing to access.

We've had these Chromebooks since Christmas and they are still working fine with no problems whatsoever.

UPDATE: 2.28.15 - My daughter brought it to my attention that these chromebooks do not have a "delete" key. Interesting.
text_fidelity_b: Acer C720 Chromebook (11.6-Inch, 2GB) **Discontinued by Manufacturer**

I mounted mine on the hand rail of my apartment balcony, second floor and now receive all local channels 4-68. Channel 68 being about 45 miles away. All are received in full green in windows media center, without using a preamp.

Previously I had it mounted under and bolted to the 3rd floor balcony to try and keep it out of sight. Reception was iffy on 4 favorite channels. I then moved it to its' present location with the idea that the antennas footprint is considerably smaller than all the satellite dishes mounted on balconies throughout the complex. The mounting bracket and pole that come with it, are the same type satellite dishes use, Very strong and versatile. You will need to buy some good bolts, I used 4, 5/16" x 1- 1/2" Galvanized Lag and flat washers, I predrilled 3/16" pilot holes first. I just thought I'd mention that for those not fastener savvy.

I would guess the antenna mount alone is worth 1/3rd of the entire antenna cost. Recommend a good quad shield coaxial cable with the thick, sollid copper wire. A shorter run is better if possible. I only have about 12 feet to my PC/TV.

Once I figured out how to mount this antenna correctly, a month ago, I haven't had to adjust it.
text_fidelity_b: RCA Compact Outdoor or Attic Yagi TV Antenna – HD Antenna with Super Long 75 Mile Range – Long Range Digital OTA Antenna for Clear VHF & UHF Reception, NexGenTV ™ Compatible, Supports 4K/8K 1080p TVs

Corsair Vengeance 2000 Wireless 7.1 Gaming Headset (CA-9011115-NA) For the price, this is a decent set of gaming headphones. The build quality is perfectly fine for the price point. It doesn't feel as rock solid as more expensive brands, but feels like it will certainly stand up to normal usage.

The comfort is borderline. It feels fine for up to about an hour of usage, then the ear cups start to become somewhat uncomfortable and the headband pinches a bit. It's not the best set for hours and hours of usage, but for "normal" wear times I didn't have any problems.

The sound quality is quite good. Nice amount of bass response without sounding muddy. I also found it to have more than good enough sound quality for watching movies, with the dialogue coming through clearly. It's not the best for listening to music (the mid and upper ranges are a bit constrained) but for it's intended purpose of a gaming set, no complaints at all regarding sound quality.

My major problem was with range. I love the fact that these are wireless, but placement is critical. I'd lose the signal if I didn't vary much from a specific spot near the wireless adapter. Moving just a bit out of the "zone" killed the connection. That was a disappointment since, while I didn't expect to be able to roam around the house with them on, I did expect to be able to leave my chair and go a short distance without breaking the connection. No problems with signal strength when seated or within a few feet of the adapter, but hit and miss when moving more than a few feet away.

Other than the range issue, this is a pretty good value in a gaming headphone set.
text_fidelity_b: Corsair Vengeance 2000 Wireless 7.1 Gaming Headset (CA-9011115-NA)

Bestlight 48 LED Macro Ring Light With 6 Adaptors Rings for Canon Digital EOS Rebel SL1 (100D),T5i(700D),T4i(650D),T3(1100D),T3i(600D),60D,60Da,50D,Nikon D5300,D5000,D3000,D3200,D5100 DSLR Cameras 48 LED unit - (since several items are listed under one product ID)
Positives:
- It is what it looks like, does what it claims to do, and basically works
- cheap
- comes with an AC adapter!! Wow. You can pay a lot for a light that doesn't

Negatives: I'm using this for Macro work (I'm new to macro) so that's the perspective I'm coming from
- Not Bright Enough! It's just not all that bright. Not enough to light a subject by itself for macro purposes. I doubt it's adequate for more than a highlight for portraiture. This is why 2 stars. If a light doesn't light - it's not a light.

Really that's it. This is not a knock to the light (and not why I gave it a low rating), but if you are planning on using it for macro, buy a flash instead. A flash will not only have higher output, but will help freeze the camera shake (a big macro problem). Also, I thought the full time light would be better for live insects (you can see what you're doing!), but it's the opposite. You need the flash to freeze action. Not a criticism (this light does not advertise itself as a flash), but something to know.

UPDATE: I used it a couple more times. I am finding it more useful than initially when very close in. I would still strongly recommend a flash for this unless you have a compelling reason for continuous illumination (e.g you're waiting for a bug to crawl into frame and it's too dark to see otherwise. Though the lights would probably scare the bug). If you have a pretty solid tripod setup, this can work for longer exposure macro. Not great though. Upped to 3 stars.
text_fidelity_b: Bestlight 48 LED Macro Ring Light With 6 Adaptors Rings for Canon Digital EOS Rebel SL1 (100D),T5i(700D),T4i(650D),T3(1100D),T3i(600D),60D,60Da,50D,Nikon D5300,D5000,D3000,D3200,D5100 DSLR Cameras

Mostof Dual Ring Light with Stand, Mirror, Phone Holder, Remote, for TikTok YouTube Live Stream Makeup Selfie Photography So ... 2020 .... what do you think of it so far? Our meetings for worship have been moved to Zoom online. So we are are video conferencing multiple times a week. The lighting in our office and on my Mac is great. But for those meetings we use my husband's window's based, 5 year old laptop, out in the kitchen because it runs one of the secondary programs we need to use. The lighting is just "meh". I have been trying to find a good lighting source and have tried and returned a few products out of my own pocket.

This system is a keeper. I little cumbersome, a little top heavy, a little cheap feeling in some respects, but lighting wise, when you get it adjusted is quite nice. Us personally, we look a little more like real people with better lighting.

I have included a before and after picture. I am not a selfie taker, just a pushing 50 year old, middle aged woman, so bear with my picture, I just tried to give you an idea of what some light and color adjustments can do.

Ours is set with a red filter. That seemed to work best for our laptop camera. It is set to medium brightness. Ours is extended over us with the round lights facing more downward and out of our eyes. They are positioned more over the laptop than near us and maybe a foot above the laptop. There is more play for extension with the unit, but that is what works for us.

It comes with mirrors and phone holders, etc etc. We don't use any of that right now but it gives you options. The round mirror head which the the two lights screw on to is flimsy. I would not be surprised if it breaks eventually. The weight of the lights on the small screw in assembly just don't seem like someone thought this all the way through with gravity and weight. So be forewarned. That could be improved.

Overall ... finally a lighting system that works and is pretty simple to set up. Any regrets? Actually no! Would I recommend? Yes. This definitely has a place in today's zoom, tiktok, instagram, youtubey saavy world of Influencers, and also for those of us joe-schmoes who just need better lighting.
